read_file_with_codecs: read a file at a relative path using codecs and return its contents as a string
get_version_from_init: extract the __version__ string from a Python module file like mtrl/__init__.py
parse_dependency_file: parse a requirements text file into a list of dependency strings with git egg support
review_setup_py: review the setup.py to understand package metadata, dependencies, and setuptools configuration
summarize_setup_functions: summarize the read, get_version, and parse_dependency helper functions used in setup.py
